migration_calibration.duration_semantics: coordinator _migrate_out_one_request wall time from entry to terminal status; no independent service-pause label

migration_validation.duration_semantics: coordinator _migrate_out_one_request wall time from entry to terminal status; no independent service-pause label

trace_files.join_key: request_id suffix rNNNN links trace requests to requests.csv and migration_events.request_ids

scheduler_state.batch_semantics: profiling_data tuple (stage, num_seqs, sum(seq_lens), executor_iteration_wall_ms); outer bs is scheduler num_batched_tokens and must be predecessor-step aligned

units_and_time_semantics.service timestamp: Unix wall seconds; profiling_data latency is milliseconds
units_and_time_semantics.migration observed_wall_time: Unix wall seconds; blocks is KV blocks; cost_ms is milliseconds
units_and_time_semantics.request scheduled_arrival_sec/actual_sen: seconds relative to run phase; latency columns are milliseconds
units_and_time_semantics.trace scheduled_arrival_sec: seconds relative to measurement workload start; input_tokens/output_tokens are tokens
units_and_time_semantics.GPU wall_time/relative_sec: Unix wall seconds / run-relative seconds; memory MiB, utilization percent, temperature Celsius, power watts

engine_latency_measurement.scope: from Ray executor dispatch through awaited worker result
